changes.text: Runtime smoke test plays every audio effect through the real pipeline
15 new audio effects and a stackable /effect command
Bass boost, 8D, nightcore and echo now clearly change the sound
Music notifications now post in the /play or /join channel

title: A warmer home for good company

changes.text: A light theme, shared navigation and footer, and a separate fictional player and chat preview.
A searchable slash command guide derived from the bot registry, and this filterable changelog.
Live public status now includes restart information, a ticking uptime counter, 15-second refreshes, and retry states.
Replaced the viewport-width navbar backplate and constrained grids, marquees, and background layers to prevent horizontal scrolling.
Server names from public playback cards. Public cards display only song details and progress.

title: Motion that knows when to slow down

changes.text: Unified staggered reveals, page transitions, responsive headline sizing, and offline colours.
Kept the aurora in a fixed ambient layer, stopped offline equalizers, and retained the last known server count.
Reduced-motion support, versioned assets, and browser checks for layout and live states.
